exposure: IP group with CPR 1.08 and above
outcome: Cesarean section rate due to fetal distress
Neonatal intensive care unit (NICU) admission rate
cohort: Pregnant women diagnosed with mild-to-moderate IP (n=70) and low-risk pregnant women (n=70)
finding: In singleton pregnancies with mild-to-moderate IP, a low CPR (<1.08) was associated with a higher risk of cesarean section due to fetal distress, lower 5-minute Apgar scores, and increased NICU admissions.
